summary: The implementation successfully addresses all five requirements. REQ-11 and REQ-12 are fully implemented with per-user data isolation in the backend and authentication enforcement in the frontend. REQ-13 delivers a comprehensive landing page with app branding, feature descriptions, and login functionality. REQ-14 provides recipient selection via Principal ID input for messages and reminders. REQ-15 restores the profile setup dialog for first-time users. All acceptance criteria are met with proper authorization checks, UI flows, and data routing.
